annotations.title: Read the shortlist of an order

description: The people of one job order, newest first: person_id, handle, name, headline, stage, source (applied: they applied; sourced: you added them), the fit Alion computed, the application they sent (note, asked pay), and their contacts only where they gave them to you (they applied, or shared them in Messages; never the email). Filter by stage or source. Needs the API key of the Alion account that posted the vacancies. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs
